about.heading: Strong tea, softly served.
about.body: Moof is an independent Singapore matcha and hojicha bar built around hand-whisked ceremonial-grade drinks, soft textures and exclusive Japanese ingredients. The menu keeps things simple: strong tea, fresh milk or oat milk, seasonal flavours and daily small-batch bakes.
about.imageAlt: A strawberry matcha and a matcha latte in Moof cups on a wooden table, beside Moof tasting cards

menuSection.heading: Pick your current mood.
menuSection.intro: Swipe through our house favourites and small seasonal detours.

story.heading: Two matcha, whisked to order.
story.body: We pour two Japanese matcha side by side. Mori is deep green with a rounded finish, for richness and body. Shiran is the smoother profile, for clean, bright drinks and layered milk tea. Every cup is whisked fresh, and the seasonal board changes when the produce, weather or collective mood tells us it should.
story.note: Whisked with care. Served without ceremony.

events.heading: The room is yours.
events.body: From thoughtful team mornings to intimate wedding evenings, we shape the drinks, bakes and room around your kind of gathering.
events.imageAlt: The Moof shopfront on Shenton Way, with orange stools lined up outside the glass

visit.heading: Come by, stay awhile.
visit.body: Find Moof at Eon Shenton in the CBD, a five-minute walk from Tanjong Pagar MRT.

business.heading: Matcha can start a good conversation.
business.body: Wholesale, collaborations, pop-ups and partnerships—we would like to hear what you are building.
